title: Wastewater Sample Processing with PEG-8000 Precipitation
author: Dilip Abraham

steps.title: Collect and Disinfect Sewage Samples
steps.instruction: Collect 350 mL of sewage samples in a sterile Whirl-Pak bag and disinfect the sampling bag with ethanol to avoid contamination.

steps.title: Transport Samples to Laboratory
steps.instruction: Transfer the sampling bag to the laboratory maintaining a cold chain at 4 °C.

steps.title: Transfer Sample to Centrifuge Bottle
steps.instruction: Transfer the sewage sample into a sterile 250 mL Nalgene centrifuge bottle.

steps.title: Add Precipitation Reagents
steps.instruction: Add PEG 8000 and NaCl to 250 mL of the sample to achieve final concentrations of 10% (w/v) and 0.3 M, respectively.

steps.title: Vortex Mixture
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture at 500 rpm for 15 minutes until the reagents are completely dissolved in the suspension.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Seal the Nalgene bottles using the cap assembly and centrifuge the mixture at 12,000 x g for 2 hours until a pellet is visible.

steps.title: Resuspend and Aliquot Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 3 mL of PBS (pH 7.4) and divide the suspension into aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 3 mL of PBS (pH 7.4)
Aliquot 1 mL of the suspension into each of 3 screw cap tubes

steps.title: Store Primary Concentrates
steps.instruction: Store the resulting pellet at -20 °C until further processing.

substeps.instruction: Limit freeze-thawing of primary concentrates to once
